3 Apr 2023
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection, with the claimant represented by counsel from the
outset. Assigned for investigation and contact made with the representative to reqeust the initial statement and
photographs.
10 Apr 2023
Reviewed the photographs submitted with the file. They confirm several details of the reported impact, although no
independent witnesses have come forward to describe the collision.
20 Apr 2023
Damage to the vheicle is mostly consistent with the impact described. A few old scratches are visible, and it is
possible they predate this loss, so they are being noted separately for the estimate.
6 Jun 2023
Confirmed that the driver lives with the policyholder and qualifies as a covered household member under the policy.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before coverage began.
26 Jun 2023
The claimant has described the event the same way in each conversation so far. It is not yet fully clear where in the
vehicle the claimant was seated at impact, so this is being followed up with the representative.
29 Jun 2023
Medical records report a shoulder injury, which is plausible for a crash of this type. No prior injury to the same area is
known, and treatment has followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved.
23 Sep 2023
Reviewed the file with the claim summary. Seating position remains the open item, and the evaluation will be updated
once the representative responds to the outstanding request.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
